display_long_description:
Transform your home into a magical battlefield where every room becomes part of the duel.

Walk, dodge, and battle naturally through your own environment while casting powerful spells using your voice and controller movements.

Using local LAN multiplayer and shared-space calibration, every player experiences the same magical world perfectly aligned with the real environment.

No virtual joystick.

No artificial movement.

Just real movement, real strategy, and real spell battles.

Features

🪄 Cast spells using voice commands.

  🔥 Fireball – Explosive ranged attacks.

  ⚡ Lightning – Fast precision magic.

   🛡 Shield – Defensive magical barriers.

🛡 Create magical barriers.

👥 Local multiplayer with shared Mixed Reality.

📍 Shared-space calibration.

🎯 Team-based matches.

🎮 Full-body physical gameplay.

🌐 LAN multiplayer.

🎤 Offline voice recognition.

⚡ Fast-paced magical combat.

Early Access

Spell Surge is in Early Access and will continue to evolve with new content and gameplay improvements.

The core gameplay experience is complete and fully playable.

Future updates will introduce:

• New spells

• More visual effects

• Improved audio

• Additional game modes

• New gameplay features

Community feedback will help shape the future of Spell Surge.

Thank you for supporting the project!
